summary: @or-sdk/apps preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (string-array rotation via a large mixed constant array, mangled identifiers) whose behavior is not readable without full deobfuscation. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io-style string-array indirection (per-function literal-lookup objects wrapping strings such as "ldd", "/etc/os-release", "Alpine", "bun", "powershell", "Expand-Archive"), hiding the drop-and-exec chain from review. Executing the payload under a freshly fetched alternate runtime bypasses Node-based install-time scanning. The package scope also mirrors an internal-only repository referenced in CHANGELOG.md (gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next), and setup.mjs and math_init.js have no counterpart under src/, consistent with a dependency-confusion package published to public npm to shadow an internal scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
